'''Tanrays''', also known as '''lava lizards''', were predatory [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] from [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. [[Tanray heart crystal]]s were named after this creature, due to the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal's]] resemblance to a tanray's [[Heart/Legends|heart]].
